message: Message name "ground_station" should be PascalCase, such as "GroundStation".
Field name "Name" should be lower_snake_case, such as "name".
Enum value name "S" should be prefixed with "BAND_".
Enum zero value name "S" should be suffixed with "_UNSPECIFIED".
Enum value name "X" should be prefixed with "BAND_".
RPC response type "Pass" should be named "WatchPassesResponse" or "OrbitServiceWatchPassesResponse".
